meta.name: l4rxx Gregor Collienne-inspired portfolio DNA
meta.description: Design DNA extracted from gregorcollienne.com and applied to a local l4rxx photography portfolio with original implementation and local image assets.

accent.role: muted separators and soft overlay support

neutral.usage: high contrast black typography on warm off-white surfaces

color.contrast_strategy: strong black-on-light contrast with image color carrying the only visual chroma

font_families.heading: Arial Narrow, Helvetica Neue Condensed Bold, Impact, sans-serif
font_families.body: Arial Narrow, Helvetica Neue Condensed Bold, Impact, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: heavy condensed uppercase sans-serif approximating the source narrow editorial type without bundling proprietary fonts

spacing.section_rhythm: large negative-space fields with small fixed controls and wide image gaps

layout.grid_system: source-style five-column offset overview grid, asymmetric twelve-column grid on work, fixed-center viewer on focus
layout.max_content_width: 118rem for list view, viewport-bound for image pages
layout.columns: 12 on desktop, single flow on mobile
layout.alignment_tendency: centered controls with asymmetric photographic placement

shape.border_usage: thin underlines and horizontal list dividers only

elevation.depth_cues: z-index staging, blur transitions, scale, and fixed layers

motion.exit_pattern: reverse blur with overlay state changes

components.button_style: unstyled text buttons with underline-on-hover or plus icon
components.navigation_pattern: centered plus opens full-screen navigation overlay
components.list_style: large uppercase rows with hard dividers and hover image preview
components.component_notes: viewer uses a scroll-driven thumbnail rail, centered fixed main image, vertical caption, and bottom text actions

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: loose contact sheet around a fixed photographer name
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary minimalist portfolio with print editorial restraint

visual_language.ornamentation: none beyond motion and image placement
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy black typography balanced against irregular photo blocks
visual_language.focal_strategy: single central name or image with peripheral navigation

composition.flow_direction: vertical scroll on desktop, horizontal thumbnail scanning on mobile focus

imagery.photo_treatment: natural color, no frames, no radius, object-fit contain/cover by context
imagery.graphic_elements: plus mark, underline rules, vertical caption

interaction_feel.feedback_style: subtle underline, hover scale, active thumbnail offset
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: image scale in grid, preview reveal in list, and center-distance thumbnail push in focus view
interaction_feel.loading_style: brief warm-white cover then staggered reveal

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: not applicable because local assets are present
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: silent fallback to first image if rel is missing

overview.fallback_strategy: respect prefers-reduced-motion by reducing transition duration

3d_elements.description: no WebGL or real 3D scene; 3D feeling comes from rotateX text/image reveal

shader_effects.description: Chrome runtime inspection found no canvas, shaderSource, framebuffer, uniform, or draw calls

scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: staggered reveal and active thumbnail offset
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: thumbnail center distance drives active image and horizontal push

text_effects.description: large uppercase text enters from blur with rotateX and vertical translation

image_effects.description: images reveal from blur/translate and scale subtly on hover

svg_animations.description: plus icon is CSS, not SVG

visual_effects.composite_notes: The source site is not shader-driven. Its fidelity comes from DOM layer choreography: fixed centered controls, sparse image placement, blur overlays, 3D rotateX text reveal, active thumbnail offsets, and rel-based focus navigation.
